title: Bib Collection Readiness Missing Metadata Exception Rate
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=race:bib
| where required_fields_missing=*
| stats sum(required_fields_missing) as missing_fields count as items by race_name
| eval avg_missing=round(missing_fields/items,2)
| where avg_missing>0
| sort - avg_missing
description: Highlights bib collection readiness records that routinely arrive with required fields missing.
value: Bad metadata is why personal admin trackers become untrustworthy, so exception rate is a useful hygiene metric.
implementation: Count missing required fields during ingest and write the total into `required_fields_missing` for each record.
visualization: Table of race values by average missing fields per record.
grandmaExplanation: It builds where the records behind bib collection readiness are missing important details and need cleanup.
